submit.title: Submit a track
submit.description: Publish your own music on HUK. You keep your files — HUK links to them and stores only metadata and hashes.
submit.betaNote: The platform is in an invite-only beta: create your artist profile by redeeming an invite code, then submit tracks.
submit.apiNote: Submission currently goes through POST /api/tracks (ARTIST sessions); the guided form ships with the console naryads.

mod.title: Moderator console
mod.forbidden: 403 — this console is for moderators and admins only.
mod.reasonRequired: A statement of reasons is required
mod.commentsHeldNote: Held comments wait for a decision; hidden comments are listed for re-approval. Hide and remove require a statement of reasons — it is shown to the commenter.

comments.title: Comments
comments.heldNotice: Every comment is reviewed by a moderator before it appears — nothing is published automatically.
comments.reported: Thank you — the report is in the moderation queue.
comments.actionFailed: The action failed. Try again later.
comments.errorRateLimited: Too many comments — try again in a few minutes.
comments.errorAccountTooNew: Accounts younger than 24 hours cannot comment yet.
comments.errorNotVerified: Listen for 30 seconds to this track first — then you can comment.
comments.errorEditWindow: Comments can be edited for 10 minutes after posting.

charts.title: Charts
charts.subtitle: Top 100, updated weekly. Computed by a fixed formula, not by AI.
charts.empty: The charts are being prepared — not enough votes yet.
charts.footnote: A track enters a chart after {minVoters} different listeners have reacted. Categories with fewer than {minTracks} tracks roll up into their parent.
charts.howIntro: Charts are arithmetic, not opinion. The same listener actions always produce the same ranking, and AI never moves a track up or down.
charts.howWhatCounts: A like counts as +{likeWeight}, a dislike as {dislikeWeight}, adding a track to a playlist as +{playlistAddWeight}. Listening to at least 80% of a track counts +{completionWeight}, once per day per listener, and +{repeatCompletionWeight} again on another day. Skipping a playlist track early counts {earlySkipWeight}. Dislikes are private: nobody sees them, including the artist.
charts.howDecay: Every action loses half of its weight every {halfLifeDays} days, so charts follow what people enjoy now.
charts.howWilson: We rank by a cautious estimate of how much people like a track (the lower bound of a {confidenceLevelPct}% confidence interval), not by the raw share of likes. Five likes out of five rank below 199 out of 200. A track needs {minVoters} different listeners to enter a chart.
charts.howFairPlay: Bursts of votes and suspicious patterns are flagged and count as zero. Reactions only unlock after a listener has actually listened for {reactionUnlockSeconds} seconds.
charts.howFresh: A pool of the {freshPoolSize} newest approved tracks gets a share of the airtime so new music can be heard before it has votes.
charts.howRollupNote: Only the top {chartLimit} tracks of a category are listed. Categories with fewer than {minTracks} eligible tracks are not shown — their tracks stay in the parent charts.
charts.howLegalNote: The legal pages are written after the legal review. Until then the links on the boards lead here.
